run_taskteacher_single: run the TaskTeacher class to load a single dialog-babi task dataset for training
run_defaultteacher_all: run the DefaultTeacher class to train on all six dialog-babi tasks at once
run_kbteacher: run the KBTeacher class to load the dialog-babi knowledge base facts dataset
review_taskteacher_init: review the TaskTeacher init method to understand how it resolves datafile and candidate paths
summarize_path_function: summarize the _path function that maps task IDs and datatypes to data file paths
